messages:
maria: looping in SE/eng/legal — RivalCo wants a POC next week to test replacing CompetitorX with Redwood. Main asks: prompt parity, response deltas, token billing, and security questionnaire. cc @samir @cheng @tom @jenny

samir: sounds good. propose 3-stage POC: 1) parity smoke, 2) edge-case stress, 3) billing/regressions. need their canonical prompts + sample sessions. also what adapter they plan to drop in?

raza: we can share 10 canonical prompts and ~2k sample sessions. prefer a drop-in adapter so app changes are minimal. we use CompetitorX header `X-Client-Key: rvl-xxxx`.

cheng: we can stand up an isolated sandbox routing with `model=redwood-compat-v1` and a small shim that maps CompetitorX headers to our auth. need their exact header example + rate limits.

maria: they asked about token billing differences — CompetitorX bills per request in their quote, not per token. finance/ops: can we get a quick delta calc? @tom legal also needs their NDA + sec questionnaire responses.

jenny: security side — send their vendor questionnaire and SOC2 scope, we'll map gaps. if they require KMS in their VPC or HSM, private deployment timeline is longer (~4-6 weeks).

tom: legal: NDA OK in principle; will likely redline a couple clauses. RivalCo is pushing indemnity for model outputs — we generally avoid that. sales: confirm expected ARR to evaluate concessions.

samir: small technical note: CompetitorX runs deterministic sampling (temp=0). for parity we'll run `temp=0` and `n=1` during tests. also we need to capture tokenization diffs (their tokenizer vs our tokenizer) — I'll add a token-compare step.

raza: target deal size is mid-six figures ARR. indemnity is a procurement blocker; they will accept a standard limited liability cap if we include a content disclaimer.

maria: noted. POC infra: I'll provision a dedicated sandbox with isolated billing. IP allowlist: 52.23.12.45/32 and 18.197.66.0/24 — can infra confirm?

cheng: confirmed — added to staging allowlist. note: enabling KV/prefix cache changes behavior for stateful sessions; we'll test with cache on/off. also created a small header mapping snippet:

```
# header mapping example (shim)
if incoming.headers.get('X-Client-Key'):
  outgoing.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer ' + map_key(incoming.headers['X-Client-Key'])
```

samir: I'll author an evaluation checklist and include a response-delta metric: token-level edit distance threshold < 0.12 for top-1 responses. reasonable?

jenny: security Q: they want evidence of encryption at rest + KMS rotation logs. we can provide rotation logs via Cloud KMS + audit export. ask if they require HSM-backed keys.

tom: procurement also requires a recent 3rd-party pen test report. we can provide the redacted report.

raza: for the POC we'd prefer hosted API first, escalate to dedicated only if perf/cost requires it. also: can you confirm streaming behavior vs CompetitorX (they chunk aggressively)?

cheng: streaming semantics match our RFC: chunked JSONL events. small latency diffs expected but we can simulate their 50ms chunk pacing if needed.

samir: quick pricing note: assume 10M tokens/month — competitor quoted $0.00X per request in their pricing doc. our hosted estimate (with batching & KV) looks ~15-25% cheaper; i'll post a spreadsheet by EOD.

maria: :thumbsup: action items: samir -> eval checklist & pricing by EOD; cheng -> provision sandbox + add allowlist; jenny -> security mapping + docs; tom -> NDA & pen test; raza -> share prompts & sessions. kickoff Thurs 10am PT. any objections?

tom: none from legal. will need procurement contact.

raza: procurement contact: emma.procure@rivalco.com. sharing prompts now via box: https://rivalco.box.com/s/abc123 (credentials in DM).

samir: posted a provisional cost calc: https://docs.redwood.com/drive/po-cost-estimate/rc-poc-v1 — key takeaway: token billing likely favors us after KV caching. numbers are provisional.

cheng: POC sandbox provisioned: https://sandbox.redwood.com/rivalco (env auto-expires in 14d). using `redwood-compat-v1`. logs + debug endpoints enabled.

maria: great. any known red flags?

jenny: timeline risk only if they insist on HSM; that adds 2-3w for infra + security signoff.

raza: for POC we will NOT require HSM — rotation logs and KMS are sufficient for now.

samir: will add an eval script to measure top-k overlap and token consumption and push results here after initial run.

cheng: pushed adapter shim to repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rivalco-poc/commit/abcd1234 — includes header mapping + response normalizer.

maria: :rocket: closing loop — see everyone Thu 10am PT.
